data.description: When a necrologist's phantom reduces a creature to fewer than 0 hit points with an attack or spell, the necrologist can expend one use of her channel energy ability as a swift action to affect the same target withdeath knell. If the target fails its save, the necrologist can choose either herself or her phantom to gain the benefit of the spell.
